svg.title: Repair Tool Arguments: fix malformed JSON before validation
svg.desc: RepairToolArguments runs in the before_tool_validate hook, after the model makes a tool call and before Pydantic AI validates its arguments. Malformed JSON such as {'path': 'a.py', 'limit': 10, with single quotes, a trailing comma and a missing brace is repaired by json-repair into valid JSON, which then goes through normal schema validation. Valid arguments pass through unchanged.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
